items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: I saw Benji out at the Yacht Club not too long ago... I just wanted to talk to him about things.

ctx.x: And then he, I have been trying to find him. He was working down at what? Swigman's, you know, they closed down the late brothers on Canal Street. So they all moved away. And I had an awful time finding him. I didn't check some things out.
I saw Benji out at the Yacht Club not too long ago. There's a Benjamin J. White at Lamarck. I don't even know where that is.
That's in Algiers. Huh? That's in Algiers.
